name: Pretium Packaging
old_description: Learn more about the values that make Pretium Packaging a leader in sustainable packaging.
about:
Pretium Packaging is headquartered in Peru, Illinois. The company operates as a designer and manufacturer of rigid packaging solutions. Public sources do not disclose a founding year, ownership structure, or founder names.

The company provides full-service design and manufacturing of rigid packaging for specialized applications, focusing on small to mid-sized production volumes. Its capabilities include custom molding, printed folding cartons through its Ediprint division, and an Innovation Center near Chicago offering single-cavity prototyping, design collaboration rooms, and market simulation shelves. Pretium operates 26 locations across five countries, employs approximately 2,800 associates, maintains 2,100 stock molds, offers 875 custom colors, and launches about 110 new products annually.

Pretium serves a broad range of industries requiring rigid packaging. Its certifications indicate a focus on regulated sectors: ISO 13485:2016 for medical devices, BRCGS and FSSC 22000 for food safety, and U.S. and Canadian Drug Master Files for pharmaceutical packaging. The company uses only FDA-approved raw materials and supports HACCP plans.

Pretium differentiates itself through a flexible manufacturing network with redundant tooling and over 2,000 stock options for faster delivery, a dedicated innovation team and lab for rapid prototyping, a sustainability program that includes vegetable inks and FSC-certified cardboard, and a quality system featuring in-house leak detection, metal detection, vision inspection, and SPC data collection calibrated to NIST standards.
